sec: Test VI: Programming / Problem Solving (15 pts)
inst: Directions: Write a complete and working C# console program for each problem. Follow proper naming conventions, indentation, and syntax. Partial credit may be given for correct logic even with minor syntax errors. Each item is worth 5 points.

qts.question: Write a C# program that asks the user to input 5 integers and displays their sum, average, highest value, and lowest value.

Create a class called "Student" with the following attributes: name (string), studentNumber (string), and GPA (double). Include a constructor, appropriate getters and setters, and a method called DisplayInfo() that prints all student information in a formatted manner. Instantiate the class in the Main method and call DisplayInfo().
Write a C# program that reads 10 integers from the user, stores them in an array, and uses a method called BubbleSort() to sort the array in ascending order. Display the unsorted and sorted arrays.
